title: Deals: the Pixel 11 series is on sale and so is the Galaxy S26 series
description: Now that the foldable fever is dying down following the iPhone Duo launch, let’s focus on slab phones this week. title: Apple’s busy week, iPhone Duo troubles and Poco X8s debut, Week 43 in review
description: Another week in the books, so let’s do a recap. Apple had a packed few days, announcing new MacBook Pro models with OLED touchscreens, an OLED iPad mini, and a major Creator Studio update. title: Honor 700 and 700 Pro will reportedly support a teleconverter
description: Honor's 700 series is expected to launch in China next month, and two well-known tipsters on Weibo have shared a few more details about it. description: With the arrival of iOS 27, Apple was hoping to make up a lot of ground in the AI space, but the new and improved Apple Intelligence comes with a huge caveat. In an official statement, Lava said, "In the current industry environment, ongoing memory shortages have necessitated a price revision of up to INR3,000 across our smartphone portfolio, effective 15th November, 2026. title: Weekly poll: do touchscreens on laptops make sense?
description: “We’ve done tons of user testing on this and it turns out it doesn’t work. Touch surfaces don’t want to be vertical. It gives a great demo, but after a short period of time you start to fatigue and after an extended period of time, your arm wants to fall off. It doesn’t work. It’s ergonomically terrible.” This is what Steve Jobs said about laptops with touchscreens back in 2010 – it’s hardly a new idea, but sixteen years later Apple announced its first such laptops, the MacBook Pros with PROLED XDR displays. description: Oppo flagships were never cheap, but the latest generation may be too expensive to achieve the popularity that it deserves, given the excellent hardware of the phones themselves. title: Nothing Phone (4a), (4a) Pro, (3a), and (3a) Pro are now receiving the stable update to Android 17
description: Nothing started rolling out the stable version of Nothing OS 5.0 based on Android 17 to the Nothing Phone (3) earlier this month, and now four more devices are joining in. description: HMD launched the Pulse Pro back in April 2024, and now a refreshed version of the device has shown up at a retailer in Thailand according to a tipster on X. title: Motorola Signature 27 flexes muscle on Geekbench ahead of November 5 launch
description: Motorola announced the Signature 27 in September at the Snapdragon Summit, where Qualcomm introduced the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chips. description: Samsung put an under-display camera on the inner screen of its book-style foldables for four generations, starting with the Galaxy Z Fold3 back in 2021 and ending with the Galaxy Z Fold6. Now, the under-display camera will reportedly make a comeback next year. title: WhatsApp announces new features, including Group Status
description: WhatsApp has announced new features. First is Group Status, which, as the name suggests, lets you share Status updates visible only to group members, who can view, react to, and like the statuses, and add their own. Group Statuses, like regular statuses, disappear after 24 hours. WhatsApp already lets group admins share a group's message history with new members when they are being added to the group. title: Here's when Samsung plans to release its Android XR glasses and where
description: Earlier this month, a report out of South Korea claimed that Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear would launch in November, citing "a Samsung official". title: A new vulnerability can brick your Android phone when receiving the SMS of Death
description: Security researcher Mark Blaszczyk found a new scary vulnerability that affects phones running Android 12 or later. It involves receiving a specially crafted WAP Push SMS message that Android's telephony framework cannot properly process. The tricky part is that instead of displaying the message in the inbox, Android tries to process it in the background. This triggers an error that can cause all sorts of issues. Active phone calls start to disconnect, the device temporarily loses cellular service, and when receiving multiple messages like this, the device can even become unusable....
